headline: Reason for Fewer Affordable Housing Units: Tax Burden, Says CREDAI; 30-50% of Flat Price Is Tax
summary: Developers say a tax burden of 30-50% of flat prices is preventing them from building affordable homes. CREDAI has urged the government to cut taxes.
why: CREDAI is India's industry body for private real estate developers, and tax policy directly affects housing construction costs and prices.
